name: leandojo-benchmark-4-random-sft
description: A subset/variant from the LeanDojo ecosystem intended for supervised fine-tuning of models on Lean theorem-proving tasks. It provides randomly sampled SFT examples (proof steps, tactic sequences, and related code) to evaluate models' ability to generate correct proofs and tactic scripts. The benchmark focuses on formal reasoning and code generation within the Lean theorem prover.
reputation: Part of the Lean/automated theorem-proving research ecosystem with growing attention from the formal methods and ML-for-math communities, but relatively specialized.
